paragraphs: I work where data engineering, analytics and AI meet. I frame open-ended business questions, define KPIs, model scenarios and turn the results into tools and recommendations that leaders actually use.

Today I own analytics workstreams at Natera, including Voice of Patient, AI Disposition and Twilio/Calabrio reconciliation. I also lead a modernization workstream for a mission-critical gas-electric incident notification system at Consolidated Edison.

At PSEG I built Fleet Forecaster with React, Flask, PostgreSQL and Python. It cut processing from 6 hours to 5 minutes and generated approximately $120K in annualized savings. Earlier consulting work at ASH-TECH Solutions generated $200K+ in client value.

Outside work I build LLM agents, ML infrastructure and evaluation tooling. My published research includes GRAFT, a gRPC-routed agent framework (ACM AI and Agentic Systems, 2026), and Branch-Commit-Validate for autonomous red-team agents (Springer SAM, 2025).
